post_text:
@Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts has named 13 hotels and resorts for 2027 and beyond, from The Park Gstaad to its first resort in Japan.

The list, published on 20 October under President and CEO @Alejandro Reynal, mixes returning icons with new destinations:

– The Park Gstaad, A Four Seasons Hotel, back after a transformation led by the studio of @Joseph Dirand
– Four Seasons Hotel Berlin, in the 19th-century building of the Hotel de Rome
– Four Seasons Resort and Residences Okinawa, the brand's first resort in Japan, designed by @Kengo Kuma & Associates and Kuniken
– Four Seasons Resort The Biltmore Santa Barbara, a returning beachfront address
– New addresses in Jeddah, Madinah, Zanzibar, Luxor, Cairo, Beirut, Belize, the Dominican Republic and Jacksonville

The signal: several entries are reopenings or conversions of historic hotels rather than new builds. For owners of heritage assets in Europe, a global brand is increasingly a partner for the next chapter, not only for ground-up projects.

Which opening on this list would you book first?

Read the full article: https://hospitality-signals.com/signal-of-the-week/2026-10-20-four-seasons-2027-openings/
